preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The integer K is between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: S consists of alphanumeric characters and dashes
preconditions.description: The string S contains only alphanumeric characters and dashes.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is the same as the input string S.

postconditions.expression: output[i] in '0-9A-Z-' for i in range(len(output))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either a digit, an uppercase letter, or a dash.

postconditions.expression: output.count('-') == S.count('-') - (N - 1) for N in range(len(S) // (K + 1) + 1)
postconditions.description: The number of dashes in the output string is equal to the number of dashes in the input string minus the number of groups minus one.

postconditions.expression: all(len(group) == K for group in output.split('-') if group) or len(group) >= 1 for group in output.split('-')
postconditions.description: Each group, except possibly the first one, has exactly K characters, and the first group has at least one character.
All lowercase letters in the input string are converted to uppercase in the output string.
